svg.title: Timeline, detailed view, 2025-01-31 to 2026-10-05
svg.desc: 30 milestones in order along a vertical line, alternating sides, then what is planned; spaced by order, not by time. A pill marks each new year and a break marks each gap of more than a month. The same list follows as text.
